load_json_to_df_basic: load a JSON file into a pandas DataFrame using the load_json_to_df function
load_json_to_df_with_index: load a JSON file into a DataFrame and set a specific column as the index
load_json_to_df_unsorted: load a JSON file into a DataFrame without sorting the index
load_json_to_df_compressed: load a compressed JSON file like json.gz into a pandas DataFrame
load_json_to_df_rename_index: load a JSON file into a DataFrame and rename the index column
